departmentId.description: Department of the new account; defaults to the one requested

role.description: Role of the new account; defaults to MEMBER

decidedBy.description: Email of the administrator who decided

note.description: The reason given when the request was rejected

name.description: Display name, at most 60 characters. Defaults to "API key" when missing or blank

scopes.description: What the key may do. Known scopes: ingest:checkins (POST /api/ingest/checkins). Defaults to none

subjectDepartmentId.description: The department the event is about, if any

subjectUserId.description: The user the event is about, if any

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next (older) page; null on the last page

BudgetImportRow.description: Department and category by name; quarter 1 to 4 (or Q1 to Q4)

BudgetLine.description: A budget line with what has been spent against it. Lines with a null id have spending but no budget (amount 0).

committed.description: SUBMITTED expenses dated in the quarter

remaining.description: amount - spent - committed (negative when over budget)

spent.description: APPROVED plus PAID expenses dated in the quarter

BudgetRequest.description: One budget line: a department, a category and a quarter

quarter.description: Null when the whole year was asked for

departmentId.description: For SET_DEPARTMENT; null removes the users from their department

error.description: Why this user was not changed (written for the end user); null when ok

user.description: The user after the change; null when not ok

currentPassword.description: The caller's current password, to confirm the change

CheckinImportRow.description: The goal by goalId, or by department and goal name (the goal of the quarter that contains the date); date as YYYY-MM-DD, default today

date.description: Defaults to today. Must be inside the goal's quarter and not in the future

description.description: Shown in the audit log. Defaults to "Exported data" when missing or blank

eventType.description: Only export_generated is accepted; any other value is rejected with 400

userId.description: An active member of the department with the MANAGER or ADMIN role; null clears it

score.description: Weighted average attainment of the goals that have check-ins; null when none

trend.description: Six monthly scores, oldest first, ending with the quarter's last month (or this month)

managerId.description: The head of the department; null when it has none, or for anonymous callers

ErrorResponse.description: The body of every error response

message.description: What went wrong, written for the end user and shown as-is
message.example: You do not have permission to do this (USER_DELETE)

overBudget.description: True when, at submission, the amount exceeded the remaining budget of its line

ExpenseActions.description: What the caller may do with this expense right now

ExpenseCategory.description: A spending category shared by budgets and expenses

active.description: Inactive categories stay on old records but cannot be picked for new ones

usageCount.description: Budget lines plus expenses that use this category

ExpenseImportRow.description: Department and category by name; date as YYYY-MM-DD; status DRAFT, SUBMITTED, APPROVED or PAID (default SUBMITTED); submitterEmail defaults to the importer

totalAmount.description: Sum of every matching expense, not only this page

ExpensePaymentRequest.description: Mark an approved expense as paid

paidOn.description: Defaults to today; not in the future

date.description: When the money was spent; not in the future

reference.description: Invoice number or other external reference

submit.description: Create only: true submits it straight away instead of saving a draft

email.description: Email address of the account to reset

attainment.description: Progress from baseline to target in percent, clamped to 0..120; null without check-ins

canEdit.description: The caller may edit or delete the goal

currentValue.description: Value of the latest check-in; null when there is none

canDelete.description: The caller may delete this check-in

recordedBy.description: Email of the person, or "API key: name" for integrations

GoalRequest.description: Create or edit a goal (a KPI with a target for one quarter)

target.description: Above the baseline when higher is better, below it when lower is better

unit.description: Free text, e.g. %, count, hours, days, EUR, score

weight.description: 1 to 100, default 1. Weights the goal in the department score

date.description: Defaults to today. Must be inside the goal's quarter and not in the future

link.description: Single-use link to the reset page; give it to the user

Payment.description: An outgoing payment: a PAID expense

items.description: This page of payments, newest first

months.description: Every month in the range, oldest first, including empty ones

PaymentProvider.description: No payment provider is connected: payments are recorded, not sent

score.description: Department score at the end of the month; null when no goal had data

message.description: Message to show to the person who registered

budget.description: Budget for the range: each quarter's budget times the share of its days in the range

utilisation.description: spent / budget in percent; null when there is no budget

ReportHeadcount.description: Users per department; departmentId is null for unassigned users

monthlySpend.description: Every month in the range, oldest first, including empty ones

performanceYear.description: The quarter the performance scores are for: the one that contains 'to'

token.description: The single-use token from the reset link

builtIn.description: Whether the role is defined in SystemRoles (reset on every start-up)

value.description: For orgTimezone, an IANA zone id such as "Europe/Bucharest". For worldClocks, a JSON array of {"label", "tz"} objects encoded as a string

canEdit.description: Whether the caller may edit this user (USER_UPDATE and the manager scope rules)

departmentManagerId.description: The head of the user's department, if it has one

managerOf.description: The department this user is the head of, or null

lastLoginAt.description: Last successful sign-in; null if the user never signed in

managerOf.description: The id of the department this user is the manager (head) of, or null

total.description: Users matching the filters, on all pages

events.description: Event names to deliver; "*" means every event. Defaults to ["*"] when missing or empty

url.description: http(s) address that receives the events, at most 255 characters
